summary: Gap-up openings occurred in 47/71 observations; 42/71 closed above the previous close. The median session return was +0.155%. Bullish intraday candles occurred in 35/71 sessions. The following session was positive in 42/71 available observations. Ordinary-session positive frequency over the same date span was 53.9% (includes event sessions). Three-session direction reversed in 39/70 observations with nonzero prior and subsequent returns. Nakshatra and Gandamool intervals use the first overlapping regular session; nested events are not independent confirmations. These descriptive results do not establish a predictive edge.
